scope: Actual agent view_image inspection of two native images and two dedicated material-fixture browser captures. This is a bounded material review, not whole-level integration or original-game fidelity approval.
observations: Grass has short grey-green blades and restrained diffuse mottling. Dirt is grey-ochre with fine pebbles, without horizons, embedded props or directional cast shadows.
The flat3x3 view reveals recurring fine mottling, especially on dirt. A faint broad edge-tone change can be found when looking for tile boundaries; this is not mathematically seamless continuity.
No strong hard grid or distracting sharp seam was observed at the inspected1536x800 flat or oblique game-like display scale. The oblique view remains readable and reasonably homogeneous.
These images contain baked colour detail only. No real normal, roughness, height or original-game material extraction is supplied.
limits: Visual acceptance is limited to the two actual material planes, RepeatWrapping3x3 and the captured scales. The expanded Eden level needs its own integration review.
Large flat surfaces or unusually close zoom can reveal repeated patterns; low-frequency texture variation should not be described as fully seamless.
